context.zh: 个人独立关卡设计与实现
context.en: Independently designed and implemented solo level-design project

summary.zh: 以圣米歇尔山城堡为主题的第三人称类魂线性关卡，从世界设定、路线流向和弱引导出发，组织潜行、环境机关、战斗与 Boss 遭遇。
summary.en: A third-person linear soulslike level set around Mont Saint-Michel Castle, organizing stealth, environmental mechanisms, combat, and a boss encounter through worldbuilding, route flow, and subtle guidance.

zh: 在高差显著的城堡空间中建立清晰的线性推进
交替安排观察、潜行、机关与战斗，形成节奏变化
使用构图、灯光和地标完成弱引导
en: Create clear linear progression through a castle with pronounced verticality
Alternate observation, stealth, mechanisms, and combat for pacing variety
Guide players subtly through composition, lighting, and landmarks

zh: 用垂直地标和明暗对比提示主要目标
以水位变化和升降装置改变可通行路径
在狭窄通道与开阔战斗区之间切换空间压力
en: Use vertical landmarks and value contrast to signal the main objective
Change traversable routes through water-level shifts and elevator movement
Vary spatial pressure between narrow passages and open combat spaces

zh: 通过完整流程图检查遭遇、机关与休整段落的分布
以灰盒快速验证路线、高差、视线和战斗空间
en: Used a full flow diagram to check the distribution of encounters, mechanisms, and recovery beats
Validated routes, elevation, sightlines, and combat spaces through rapid greyboxing

zh: 独立设计并在 UE5.6.1 中搭建第三人称类魂线性关卡，围绕城堡高差组织潜行、机关、战斗与 Boss 遭遇，并以构图、灯光和地标完成弱引导。
使用 Blueprint 实现升降机、动态水位、单向门与 PawnSensing 敌人侦测，通过流程图和灰盒迭代路线、视线与战斗节奏。
en: Independently designed and greyboxed a third-person linear soulslike level in UE5.6.1, using castle verticality to pace stealth, mechanisms, combat, and a boss encounter with subtle visual guidance.
Implemented elevators, dynamic water levels, one-way doors, and PawnSensing detection in Blueprint, iterating route flow, sightlines, and combat pacing through diagrams and greybox tests.

website.zh: 《圣米歇尔山城堡》是一个独立完成的第三人称类魂关卡设计项目。关卡利用城堡的垂直高差和水位变化控制路线，将潜行、环境机关、战斗和 Boss 遭遇组织为清晰的线性体验，并通过构图与地标进行弱引导。
website.en: Mont Saint-Michel Castle is an independently completed third-person soulslike level-design project. Castle verticality and changing water levels control the route, while stealth, environmental mechanisms, combat, and a boss encounter form a clear linear experience guided through composition and landmarks.

full.zh: 项目从世界设定、关卡地图和流程图开始，逐步落实敌人与环境布置、视觉氛围、潜行段落、弱引导、水位机关和 Boss 战斗。UE5 原型使用 Blueprint 实现升降机、水位变化和单向门，并通过 PawnSensing 进行敌人视野检测。灰盒由 BlockoutTools 辅助搭建；角色、敌人 AI 与动作依赖 UE 基础内容，公开工程包不重新分发这些依赖。
full.en: The project develops from world setting, level map, and flow diagram into enemy and environment placement, visual mood, stealth, subtle guidance, a water-level mechanism, and a boss encounter. The UE5 prototype implements elevators, water-level changes, and one-way doors in Blueprint, with PawnSensing for enemy detection. Greyboxing uses BlockoutTools; character, enemy AI, and animation dependencies come from UE starter content and are not redistributed in the public source package.
